label: PRODUCTION_READINESS -- states what is built, what hosted CI has run, what a deployment must provide, and what the owner must do; no compliance or production claim

statuses.IMPLEMENTED: built and tested locally at this commit; hosted CI at this tranche's head has not yet run it
statuses.HOSTED_TESTED: IMPLEMENTED, and a hosted run at a commit whose implementation is this one passed (runs cited)
statuses.DEPLOYMENT_REQUIRED: this code cannot provide it alone; the deployment must, and DEPLOYMENT.md says how to check
statuses.EXTERNALLY_BLOCKED: needs an owner action, credentials or settings outside this repository

production_ready_when: every row is HOSTED_TESTED, or DEPLOYMENT_REQUIRED with its deployment check passing at the deployment; no row EXTERNALLY_BLOCKED or UNVERIFIED
